title: Stage generation provenance
description: stages/<language>/generations/<NNNNNN>/provenance.yaml: who produced each payload of one immutable generation, from which source bytes, with which runtime and dependency identities, and at which semantic boundary. It lists every payload with its size, sha256 and row ids. It cannot carry the snapshot digest, because the digest covers this file; the ledger carries it. See docs/stage-corpus-contract.adoc.

producers.description: Every producer a payload names, keyed by a short local name. A generation that keeps earlier legacy payloads and adds stage-gem payloads lists both producers.

payloads.description: Sorted by `path` bytes, one entry per file under payloads/, no more and no fewer.

file.description: A file at an exact commit of a repository, with its sha256.

kind.description: `legacy-oracle`: the plurimath facade gem at a recorded commit. `stage-gem`: a language stage gem. `tracked-import`: rows imported from another tracked repository, with no oracle run.

generator.description: The script that wrote the payload bytes, as a file at an exact commit.

inputs.description: Every data file the generator read besides itself (seeds, imported tables), each at an exact commit with its sha256.

lockfile.description: The resolved dependency lock: a file with its digest, or the summary recorded by the legacy generator.

dependencies.description: Direct runtime dependency name to exact version.

compiler.description: Grammar compiler identity, or null when no grammar was compiled.

binding.description: Declared binding artifact identity, or null.

semantic_boundary.description: What the rows' expectations are: facade outputs (preprocessed text, writer renderings, refusals), the raw grammar tree, the typed model, the typed model with its own serialization, or cross-language roundtrip outcomes.

source.description: Where these bytes came from. `copy`: byte-identical to the named file, so its sha256 equals this payload's. `generated`: written by the producer's generator from its inputs. Row-level spec references live in the rows or in the generator inputs.

rows.description: The payload's case ids, in file order. Links every replayable row to this payload's producer and source.
